\chapter{Bitwise Operators and Their Algebra}
\label{ch:operators}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Six operators and a handful of identities: AND, OR, XOR, NOT and the two shifts, with the algebra that links them to $+$ and $-$.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{800}{1500}{5}{10}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item AND, OR, XOR and NOT bit by bit; truth tables and the laws (commutative, associative, distributive, De Morgan)
    \item Shifts: $x \ll k = x\cdot 2^k$, arithmetic versus logical right shift, and the undefined shifts ($k \ge$ width, negative $x$)
    \item Testing, setting, clearing and toggling bit $i$; \texttt{1 << i} versus \texttt{1LL << i}
    \item Identities: $a + b = (a \oplus b) + 2(a \,\&\, b)$, $a + b = (a \mid b) + (a \,\&\, b)$, and $a \oplus b \le a + b$
    \item Operator precedence in C++ (\texttt{a \& b == c} is a bug) and how to read bitwise code safely
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Test, set, clear and toggle} --- Minimum Bit Flips to Convert Number {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2220)}, Minimum Flips to Make a OR b Equal to c {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1318)}
    \item \textbf{Shifts} --- Number of Steps to Reduce a Number to Zero {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1342)}, Number of Even and Odd Bits {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2595)}
    \item \textbf{Identities between arithmetic and bitwise operators} --- Sum of Two Integers {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 371)}, XORwice {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1421A)}
    \item \textbf{Operators over a range of numbers} --- Bitwise AND of Numbers Range {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 201)}, And Then There Were K {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1527A)}
    \item \textbf{Choosing a number under bitwise constraints} --- Minimize XOR {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2429)}, Boboniu and Bit Operations {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 1395C)}
\end{enumerate}
